name: MOLD
shortDesc: Folder template creator for Premiere Pro
fullDesc: MOLD lets you create and apply reusable folder structure templates inside Adobe Premiere Pro, keeping your projects organized effortlessly.

name: Deep Duplicate
shortDesc: True nested sequence cloning for Premiere Pro
fullDesc: Deep Duplicate clones sequences properly — including all nested sequences inside them. Each clone is fully independent, with nested sequences auto re-linked. No more manually re-linking after duplicating.
features: Clone active sequence with all its nested sequences
Clone all sequences in the project at once
Add a custom suffix to all cloned sequences
Fully independent clones — edits don't affect the original
